findings.description: The single-file wrap check was changed from `isinstance(filename, str)` to `isinstance(filename, os.PathLike)`, so a plain string filename is no longer wrapped in a tuple.
findings.rationale: With click.edit(filename="notes.txt"), a str is not PathLike, so it is passed unwrapped to ed.edit_files, which iterates the string character by character and tries to open files named 'n', 'o', 't', and so on. The user sees the editor fail or open wrong files instead of notes.txt, and the intended edit does not happen.
